text: There aren't many pneumatic tube systems left in the world.

would have a few of them for sending messages around, either within a building or between buildings.
At one point, New York had 27 miles of pneumatic tubes between post offices.
And you can still see them sometimes, in American drive-through banks,
or in a few hospitals for quickly moving samples around. Last year, I visited one in Canada that's used for
transmitting small amounts of radioactive stuff for medical therapy.
